functionality.rationale: Incorrect discovery commands or peer events would desynchronize native and Flutter peer state.

security.rationale: Untrusted peer names and endpoints must cross the ABI as bounded caller-owned copies.

performance.rationale: Peer event bursts and snapshot recovery must remain bounded without blocking the UI thread.

compatibility.rationale: The additive discovery ABI must preserve existing symbols, struct negotiation, and Dart decoding.

concurrency.rationale: Event overflow, callback wakeups, snapshots, and shutdown can race across the FFI boundary.

platform.rationale: The dynamic library and Dart adapter must behave consistently on all three desktop platforms.

persistence.rationale: The discovery ABI exposes ephemeral snapshots and adds no durable format.

adr.rationale: The task adds the first public P1 operation and event extension to the C ABI.

architecture.rationale: The existing presentation-to-C-ABI dependency direction is unchanged.

roadmap.rationale: An adapter does not complete the discovery roadmap item without Flutter integration.

acceptance.note: Accepted by the integration owner after repository verification.
